title: Highboy Hideaway | KEY.co
description_expanded: A friend of mine and I stayed at Highboy Hideaway with our teenage daughters and friends and loved every minute of it. The home is in a great, quiet location in Seaside and is absolutely stunning! It is decorated beautifully and the designers have made the most of the space. We had plenty of room for a party of 7, allowing everyone to have a private space. With two sets of washer/dryers, an elevator, and a large game room, this lovely home was perfect. We’ve been renting homes on 30A for decades and never stayed in one that had everything we could ever need, down to the smallest details. The beds were more than comfortable with high-quality linens and soft, fluffy bath towels. (It’s the little things that make this place so comfortable!) The walk to town center is about 5 minutes and then another few minutes to the beach. We hope to be back sometime again! Beyond the beautifully appointed living spaces, the home's thoughtful layout includes a master retreat on the second floor with a king-sized bed, a luxurious bathroom with a soaking tub, and direct access to a shared balcony overlooking the vibrant community. The third floor transforms into a vibrant entertainment hub with plush seating, an air hockey table, and a beverage refrigerator, ideal for evening relaxation and fun. Step outside onto the balcony for leisure moments, or ascend the spiral staircase to the tower for the most spectacular panoramic views of Seaside and the emerald waters beyond. This property is not just a stay but a sublime retreat equipped with all the amenities for a truly exceptional beach vacation.
